posts.text: Trading from Home vs Trading from a Co-Working Space, which is better? — I’d say it depends less on the location and more on how well the environment supports your trading routine. Trading from home gives you comfort, privacy, lower costs, and complete control over your setup. For someone who already has good discipline, that can be enough. The downside is that home can also bring distractions—family, phone, household work, or the temptation to keep watching the market all day. A co-working space can provide a more structured work environment. Having a dedicated place to sit and trade may help…
